summary: Capstone Holding Corp. filed an 8-K on September 28-29, 2026, reporting that it retired roughly 85% of its original $6.82 million in senior secured convertible note principal, cutting the remaining balance to $1 million and fully retiring the first of two notes issued in July 2025. Outstanding shares rose to 26,384,119 as of September 28, 2026 from 20,578,551 on August 10, 2026, reflecting 2,446,825 conversion shares and 3,358,743 shares sold under its Tumim Stone equity line. No advisor or board recommendation given. Watch dilution and equity-line overhang.
